Do you ship internationally, and who covers customs or duties?

We currently do not ship worldwide. Here’s how our shipping works:

• United States: We ship all products within the contiguous U.S., and select products to Alaska and Hawaii. • Canada: We ship select items to limited regions in Canada during the planting season. • Other international locations: We do not currently ship outside the U.S. and Canada.

Customs and duties for Canada
For orders shipping to eligible regions in Canada, all prices are listed in CAD and include all duties and taxes in the price shown. That means there are no additional customs or duty charges from us beyond what you see at checkout.

If you share where you’re located, I can clarify exactly what can be shipped to you and how timing works for your area.

turns.replyText:
How long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?

For most orders, transit time with our standard shipping is typically about 1–5 business days once the order actually ships.

A couple of helpful details:

At checkout, you’ll see a delivery calendar where you can choose an estimated arrival date that works for you. Those options already factor in our processing time plus the carrier’s usual transit time to your address.
If you use an express payment method like Shop Pay or PayPal, the system skips the calendar and automatically assigns an estimated arrival date, which is shown in your order confirmation email.
We ship via standard ground services only, and while most orders arrive on time, carrier delays or weather can occasionally affect timing, so dates are always estimates, not guarantees.

If you tell me what you’re planning to order and your state or province, I can give you a more tailored idea of timing.
